C0130.title: Shanghai Putuo Police Detain Woman for Fabricating Hotel Hygiene Claims
C0130.summary: In May 2025, China Police Online reported that Shanghai Putuo police cracked a serial provocation case. Wang had already been diagnosed with skin allergy before hotel stays, but repeatedly fabricated hotel hygiene problems to demand room-fee refunds. Police found that Wang had stayed at more than ten Shanghai hotels within one month and used the same reason to demand refunds. On April 24, police arrested Wang, who was criminally detained on suspicion of provocation.
